name: aurora
description: Ridged bands squashed flat and drifting sideways.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { createField, type FieldHandle } from '@dawitlabs/pixelfield';

  interface Props {
    class?: string;
    tint?: string;
    seed?: number;
    interactive?: boolean;
  }

  let { class: className = '', tint = undefined, seed = 0, interactive = true }: Props = $props();

  let canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;

  $effect(() => {
    const field: FieldHandle = createField(canvas, {
      generator: 'noise',
      falloff: 'up',
      scale: 0.8,
      aspect: 0.35,
      warp: 1.9,
      contrast: 1.8,
      mode: 'ridged',
      speed: 0.7,
      intensity: 1.1,
      flow: { x: 9, y: 0 },
      seed,
      tint,
      interactive,
    });
    return () => field.destroy();
  });
</script>

<canvas bind:this={canvas} class={className} aria-hidden="true"></canvas>

<style>
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
</style>
